independent_recognizer_validation.evidence_boundary: Assistant visually reviewed 75 names from 10 Dataset300 source image groups, excluding GT model/layout clues. Labels and manual directions are assessment references, not automatic production inference. No retraining or threshold tuning. Existing checkpoint training-image manifest absent, so historical overlap unknown; no hidden-test claim.

input_policy.directions: assistant visual review; identical for both models
input_policy.old_vs_new_pixels: same isolated 32px image; PP applies required internal recognition normalization

model_crop_comparison.evidence_boundary: 10GT development diagnostics on complete geometry-generated local crops. Both models receive the same isolated 32px image; PP-OCR performs its own required 48px recognition normalization. GT joined only after recognition. This is not production pipeline accuracy or unseen validation.
